result.rationale: The diff adds `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)` in salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts. Relying on statusText is a real correctness defect: HTTP/2 responses (and some proxies) have an empty reason phrase, so statusText would be '' and a successful refresh would throw HttpError 400. The standard `response.ok`/`response.status` check should be used instead. The mechanism is verifiable from the diff itself.

judged_text: Refresh success is gated on response.statusText !== 'OK' instead of response.ok/response.status. Any proxy or HTTP/2 hop that normalizes or strips the reason phrase makes statusText '' and every Salesforce refresh throws HttpError 400 despite a valid token response, breaking Salesforce for users behind such intermediaries.
